title: Report memory total
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*).

Read MemTotal from the live board (`awk '/MemTotal/{print $2; exit}' /proc/meminfo`, or device_resources if it shows the same kilobyte value). Record evidence metric `mem_total_kb` whose observed value is that integer and nothing else.

Do not change the board. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration.

NOTE: the acceptance command is executed by the bench harness AFTER your turn, with its own environment (device credentials included). Do NOT try to run it yourself, read the repo .env, or investigate how the harness injects environment — that path is blocked by design. Do the device work, verify the outcome with your own probe, record evidence, and finish.
